summary: Guardian Metal Resources PLC, a London- and NYSE American-listed tungsten explorer, furnished a Form 6-K attaching an October 30, 2026 press release disclosing exercise of options over 500,000 new ordinary shares at 14 pence each, raising GBP 70,000. Admission to AIM is expected around November 3, 2026, with shares ranking pari passu; issued capital becomes 199,597,008 ordinary shares. Cairn acts as nominated adviser, Berenberg and Tamesis as joint brokers. This is a routine option exercise and share issuance, not a special situation; watch only dilution and post-admission vote denominator mechanics.
